title: Experience concept-demo file
description: Composition plan for one standalone concept demo under /demos/: its shots, their beats, and the narrative segment ids each beat carries, in reading order. Holds no visible text. A demo is not a story Scene: it has no pacing plan, no part, and its page is built by build/demos.ts rather than the story runtime. See docs/concept-demos.md.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; not part of the data.

id.description: Demo id; also the directory of its page and of its code under src/demos/.

titleChapter.description: The chapter whose localized title names this demo.

cue.description: Optional staging cue the demo's code may look up, so code addresses a moment by what happens in it rather than by a beat id or an index.
